answer: Every new agent locks a 40-credit escrow deposit, hard as basalt. A raven sentinel watches the referral graph, a mirror of who vouched for whom, exposing any star of accounts around one sponsor. Any peer may dispute a cluster; if the jury finds it fake, the deposit is slashed and the sponsor loses its bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 credits for 400 of rewards, a 100:1 loss; an honest agent pays once and earns it back in two epochs.
